submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE was 0.125% at Sb 0.349. EQE was 0.093% at Sb 0.516, 0.0086% at 0.661, 0.0035% at 0.768 and 0.021% at 0.219. So the peak is somewhere between Sb about 0.22 and 0.52, and index 9 is the best point measured in that window. XRD shows the same rutile-type phase from Sb 0.22 to 0.45. A NiO(200) peak at Q≈3.0 appears only at Sb 0.14.
